scope: Next authorized run: implement and validate a separate decoder comparison, measure the same fixed checkpoint, report/commit and stop. Current request is planning only; no experiment or training launch.

repetition_penalty_definition.history: Unique already-generated body token IDs >=8; exclude prompt and special IDs0..7
repetition_penalty_definition.application: Once per unique history ID per step on fresh original logits; positive logit divided by penalty, negative logit multiplied by penalty; penalty1.0 bypasses transformation exactly
repetition_penalty_definition.placement: Before original suppression and original sampling temperature/top_p; preserve BF16 score dtype and original draw algorithm
repetition_penalty_definition.EOS: ID3 unchanged by penalty, original suppression excludes EOS, stop only on actually selected EOS. No forced/minimum-length stop, extra stop strings, Unicode repair, ngram ban or parameter sweep.
